<!-- Please read before opening this PR. -->

Thanks for the effort, and sorry to catch you here: **liustack/quickjs does
not accept pull requests.** The engine is maintained single-handedly and every
line stays author-owned, so PRs are closed without review as a matter of
policy, not as a judgment on your work.

What works instead:

- **[Open an issue](https://github.com/liustack/quickjs/issues/new/choose)**
  describing the bug or the idea. Issues get read and drive what gets built.
  If your branch shows the fix, link it from the issue as a reference.
- **Keep it in your fork.** The license means your copy is yours.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the whole picture.
